question: Where can I find the closest golf course in the vicinity of Faith Arena, Surprise, AZ?
sql: WITH target_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Faith Arena%' LIMIT 1 ), golf_courses AS ( SELECT poi_name AS name, geometry FROM pois WHERE leisure = 'golf_course' UNION ALL SELECT park_name AS name, geometry FROM parks WHERE leisure = 'golf_course' ) SELECT gc.name, ST_Distance(gc.geometry::geography, tl.geometry::geography) AS distance_meters FROM golf_courses AS gc, target_location AS tl ORDER BY distance_meters ASC LIMIT 1;

question: Do you know where I can find the nearest golf course from Strawberry Hill, San Francisco, CA?
sql: WITH origin_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Strawberry Hill%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%San Francisco%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT name, distance_meters FROM ( SELECT poi_name AS name, ST_Distance(P.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM origin_point)::geography) AS distance_meters FROM pois AS P WHERE P.leisure = 'golf_course' UNION ALL SELECT park_name AS name, ST_Distance(PA.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM origin_point)::geography) AS distance_meters FROM parks AS PA WHERE PA.leisure = 'golf_course' ) AS combined_golf_courses ORDER BY distance_meters ASC LIMIT 1;
